name: Castle Rock dirt lot on US-2 west of Leavenworth (north side of road)
basis: MP Castle Rock Getting There: drive about 2 miles west on Highway 2 from Leavenworth; large dirt parking lot on the north side; signed trail to Logger's Ledge/upper Castle Rock. SummitPost agrees (pullout ~2.7 mi from Icicle Rd). Mapped entry is named Castle Rock Trailhead, ~0.1 km from the crag.

name: Paved pullout on US-2 about a quarter mile north of Castle Rock
basis: MP Rattlesnake Rock Getting There: park at a paved pull-out on Highway 2 about a quarter-mile north of Castle Rock, river side; trail at north end of the pullout. Matched by position: nearest mapped pullout ~0.3 mi north of the Castle Rock lot.

name: Dirt lot by the Fourth of July trailhead, 9 mi up Icicle Road (no fee)
basis: MP Fourth of July Area Getting There: crags are 9 miles up the Icicle; park just right of the parking area for Fourth of July Trail, a dirt lot with no use fee. Matched to the mapped parking beside the Fourth of July Trailhead node.
